title: Backend first. Full-stack when the project needs it.
paragraphs: I'm a backend developer at Navo Cloud Solution, where I build services and REST APIs with Spring Boot and Kotlin. I'm also studying for a BCS (Hons) at IIMS College in Kathmandu.
When a product needs more than an API, I build the rest too: Android apps in Kotlin and web frontends in Next.js.
